# E0213: a minor version drops a default its predecessor filled

A defaulted field is filled when absent, and a consumer of the predecessor sees
that value. A minor version that makes the field optional leaves it absent
instead, so the same data means something different.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: *1 | int
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0213]: a in schema v0.1 was filled when absent and is now left absent
  --> lineage.cue:11:5
   |
11 |                 a?: int
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema v0.1 is a minor version, so it must accept all data schema v0.0 accepts
   = help: make the change compatible, or make this version v1.0
```
